new_learnings.text: Sector leadership can reverse violently in one day: 电子化学品Ⅱ went from #1 sector (+3%+, multiple 涨停) to #1 WORST (-3.22%) in a single session. This validates the 3-day cold-sector rule — one bad day isn't a sell, but it demands immediate attention. The mechanism: profit-taking cascades when money rotates to the next catalyst (today: metals on geopolitical surge).
new_learnings.mechanism: When a sector runs hard for 2-3 days, accumulated profits create selling pressure. A new macro catalyst (geopolitics, commodity prices) can trigger a rapid rotation as capital reallocates to the new theme.

new_learnings.text: Rule 2b (MA-distance anti-chase) prevented catastrophic entries today: 金钼股份 (dist_ma5=+12.8%) and 华锡有色 (dist_ma5=+8.6%) are in the #3 hottest sector but dangerously overextended. Without this rule, a naive momentum system would have bought them at the top. The rule is working exactly as designed — the hottest sectors often have no buyable stocks.
new_learnings.mechanism: Stocks in hot sectors attract momentum chasers who push prices far above moving averages. The MA-distance rule forces discipline: buy the sector trend but only at reasonable entry points near support.

new_learnings.text: VCP SETUP quality provides a differentiated entry signal: only 1 of 18 enriched candidates (新宙邦) has VCP data. Its contraction_ratio=0.48 (near the 0.4 threshold) combined with the massive 宁德时代 catalyst creates a compelling case that quant RPS/MA screens alone might flag as merely 'acceptable' (RPS120=87.35, below sweet spot). VCP adds a timing edge.
new_learnings.mechanism: VCP contraction patterns identify stocks that have already absorbed selling pressure and are coiling for a breakout. When combined with a fresh catalyst, this reduces the probability of buying into a false breakout.

new_learnings.text: Volume below MAVOL30 (恒铭达 at 87.1%) is an early warning of waning institutional conviction. While not a sell trigger, if volume stays below MAVOL30 for 3+ consecutive days alongside flat price action, proactive exit before the 10-day time stop may be warranted. Institutional volume is the fuel for momentum — without it, even good stocks stall.
new_learnings.mechanism: MAVOL30 below 100% means today's volume is below the 30-day average, suggesting institutional participants are stepping back. In momentum strategies, declining volume during a rally is a divergence that often precedes reversal.

new_learnings.text: The paradox of momentum investing: the strongest sectors (metals +5-7% today) have zero buyable stocks due to MA extension. Cash (91.7% of portfolio) is a valid and often optimal position. Patience to wait for pullbacks to MA5/MA10 support is what separates disciplined momentum from FOMO chasing.
new_learnings.mechanism: Strong breadth alone is not enough to force entries. Even in a 4.88:1 breadth day, if all candidates in hot sectors are extended, the correct decision is to hold cash or size small in second-tier sectors with strong individual catalysts.
